title: Observing Alerts reports a First Light detection's brightness CHANGE as its apparent magnitude, so a self-discovered transient is announced as 'mag 2.4  NAKED EYE'
summary: The named defect is gone in the tree. transient_alert_mapper.dart no longer writes the delta into the apparent-magnitude field: line 48 is `magnitude: null,`, the delta is rendered as a signed label ('Δ2.35 mag brighter than template') in the classification, and packages/skotiq_core/test/services/transients/transient_alert_mapper_test.dart already guards it. I confirmed this is the ONLY production converter from a detection to a TransientAlert (transient_alert_provider.dart:425 `.map(transientAlertFromDetection)`; the other two TransientAlert construction sites are the TNS parser and the remote-JSON parser, neither of which sees delta_mag), and that every alert.magnitude consumer guards on null without inverting behaviour: _filterAlerts keeps a null-magnitude alert, shouldNotify still notifies via notifyOnNew, the card omits the chip, addAlertToTargets stores null. I did NOT change that code and do not claim it. What I did change: the remedy was not being delivered. The Δ label rides in the classification line, and transient_card.dart rendered that line as a Row of two unconstrained Texts, so the longer First Light string overflowed and was clipped — a RenderFlex overflow at 1100px in the widget-test font and, structurally, on any phone-width card. The brightness bucket was removed and, on a narrow layout, nothing arrived in its place. That line is now one wrapping Text.rich, and a new widget test drives the real Observing Alerts surface (TransientsView, the widget science_screen.dart:232 embeds) end to end.
test: packages/skotiq_app/test/screens/transients/first_light_delta_not_magnitude_test.dart (4 tests) + the pre-existing packages/skotiq_core/test/services/transients/transient_alert_mapper_test.dart (6 tests). The new test pumps TransientsView with an alert built by the production mapper from the reproduced row (kind=newSource, delta_mag=-2.35, snr=18.4) and asserts no NAKED EYE / BINOCULAR / SMALL SCOPE bucket, no 'mag N' chip, and that 'Δ2.35 mag brighter' is rendered inside the TransientCard at both 1100px and 390px width.
revert_check: Two independent reverts, both re-run. (1) transient_alert_mapper.dart:48 `magnitude: null,` -> `magnitude: detection.deltaMag?.abs(),` (the original line): skotiq_core mapper test goes 6 pass -> 3 fail, and the new widget test fails with 'Found 1 widget with text "NAKED EYE"'. Restored: both green. (2) transient_card.dart:111 Text.rich -> the original Row of two Texts: the new widget test goes 4 pass -> 3 fail with 'A RenderFlex overflowed' (creator Row <- Column <- Expanded, transient_card.dart:111), including at 390x844. Restored: 4 pass.
caveats: Shared-file discipline: skotiq_core test/services/transients/ is 57/57 green and skotiq_app test/screens/transients/ is 16/16 green. The full skotiq_app suite was run (concurrently with another agent's test run on the same machine) and stood at +2848 -45 across 21 files when I stopped waiting; none of those 21 can be reached by this change — `TransientCard` has exactly one usage in the whole tree (transients_screen.dart:183) and no failing file imports it, they are the captures_landscape / golden screenshot harnesses plus framing / first_light_view / your_sky. transient_alert_mapper.dart appears in files_changed for whitespace only: `dart format` reported it dirty (a mis-indented continuation inside the notes interpolation left by the wave that fixed it), which would fail scripts/pre-commit.sh. Its logic is byte-for-byte what I found (git diff stat 67+/11- before and after). Not verified on hardware or in a running app — widget-test only; the RenderFlex overflow is proven in the test font, and the structural cause (unconstrained Text in a Row, no Flexible/ellipsis) is font-independent. `dart analyze` on skotiq_app and skotiq_core reports two `non_abstract_class_inherits_abstract_member` errors (project_tracking_active_window_test.dart:13, imaging_service_keeper_numbering_test.dart:87) that come from a concurrent agent's in-flight change to skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/clock_provider.dart adding Clock.utcOffset — not from this work.
